gates.name: Dimensional Consistency
gates.rule: Verify dimensional homogeneity across all model terms
gates.test_verification: Verified: Dimension-violating hypothesis rejected at Gate D

gates.name: Applicable Conservation Constraints
gates.rule: Evaluate energy, momentum, flux drift <= tolerance
gates.test_verification: Verified: Energy conservation drift > 1e-4 rejected at Gate C

gates.name: Measurement Agreement
gates.rule: Evaluate empirical residual sqrt(sum(pred - y)^2 / N) <= max_tolerance
gates.test_verification: Verified: Zero observation hypothesis fails Gate M, marked THEORETICALLY_ADMISSIBLE, not MEASUREMENT_SUPPORTED

gates.name: Falsifier Survival
gates.rule: Reject overfitting (free_params > N_meas) and unwarranted source identification (null_space > 0 and is_source_identified)
gates.test_verification: Verified: Overfitting model rejected; ambiguous source identification rejected fail-closed

gates.name: Repeatability / Replay Invariance
gates.rule: Evaluate prediction consistency across independent repeat observation datasets
gates.test_verification: Verified: Deterministic certificate issued when all 5 gates pass

governing_principles.mathematical_vs_physical: A mathematically coherent model without empirical observations is THEORETICALLY_ADMISSIBLE at best, never MEASUREMENT_SUPPORTED
governing_principles.fail_closed_epistemics: Every gate is evaluated in strict order; failure halts promotion immediately and issues falsification record with cryptographic timestamp
